anchors: Maroon Bells and the Elk Mountains
p0010.note: The town of Aspen and Snowmass Village plus the mountains and valley around them, within about an hour. Excludes Glenwood Springs and the Crystal River hot springs.

p0011.note: The Brahmaputra valley of Assam plus the hill states beside it. Excludes Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh and Darjeeling.

p0018.note: Banff and Jasper National Parks and the Icefields Parkway between them. Excludes Kananaskis and the Kootenay and Yoho parks except where the Parkway passes them.

p0034.note: The whole country: the Angkor temples, Tonlé Sap lake, the Mekong at Phnom Penh, the southern coast and islands, and the Cardamom and Elephant mountains.

p0052.note: The whole island: Havana and the colonial cities, Viñales, the beaches (Varadero and the northern cays), the Sierra Maestra and Baracoa.

p0058.note: The whole country: east coast beaches, the Samaná Peninsula, the colonial centre of Santo Domingo, the north coast, and the Cordillera Central mountains.

p0063.note: Argentine Patagonia in Los Glaciares National Park: El Chaltén and the Fitz Roy range in the north, El Calafate and the Perito Moreno Glacier in the south. Excludes Chilean Torres del Paine and Ushuaia.

p0070.note: The Society Islands (Tahiti, Moorea, Bora Bora, Huahine) plus the Tuamotu atolls of Rangiroa and Tikehau. Excludes the Marquesas and Austral islands.

p0088.note: Komodo National Park and its boat trips from Labuan Bajo, plus Flores overland (Bajawa and the Kelimutu crater lakes). Excludes Bali and Lombok.

p0089.note: Kruger National Park and the private reserves on its western edge (Sabi Sands, Timbavati), plus the Blyde River Canyon and Panorama Route that most trips pair with it.

p0093.note: The whole country: the Mekong at Luang Prabang, the karst of Vang Vieng and Nong Khiaw, the Plain of Jars, the Bolaven Plateau and the 4,000 Islands of the far south.

p0113.note: The whole country: Bagan, Inle Lake, Mandalay and the Irrawaddy, Yangon, Hpa-An karst, the Rakhine coast (Ngapali) and the Shan hills.

p0115.note: Napa Valley, Sonoma Valley and the Russian River Valley, plus the Sonoma Coast to the west. Excludes San Francisco and the Mendocino coast.

p0123.note: All six counties: Belfast, the Causeway Coast and the Antrim Glens, the Mournes, the Fermanagh lakes, Derry~Londonderry and Strangford Lough.

p0124.note: The northern safari circuit (Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Tarangire, Lake Manyara), Kilimanjaro, and Zanzibar for the coast. Excludes the southern parks (Nyerere, Ruaha) and the Western lakes.

p0134.note: The Coachella Valley around Palm Springs and Joshua Tree National Park, with Mount San Jacinto above Palm Springs. Excludes Death Valley and the Mojave Preserve.

p0141.note: Phuket and the Andaman Sea coast to the east and south: Phang Nga Bay, Krabi, Railay, the Phi Phi and Lanta islands and Khao Sok National Park.

p0147.note: Quebec City and Montreal, the Laurentians and Eastern Townships around them, Charlevoix and the Saguenay Fjord downriver.

p0189.note: Vancouver, the Sea to Sky Highway and Whistler, with Squamish and Garibaldi Provincial Park along the way. Excludes Vancouver Island and the Okanagan.

p0196.note: The whole country: Eryri, the Brecon Beacons, the Pembrokeshire and Gower coasts, Anglesey, Cardigan Bay and Cardiff.
